children: ALLIANCE ENTERTAINMENT HOLDING CORP reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $1149M and diluted EPS of $0.26. Revenue rose 8% year over year while net income fell to $13.1M from $15.1M a year earlier, reflecting mixed category performance and investments in operations.
Revenue was $1149M, compared with $1063.5M in the prior year; YoY change 8%.
Net income was $13.1M, compared with $15.1M in the prior year; YoY change (13.4%).
Diluted EPS was $0.26, compared with $0.3 in the prior year; YoY change (13.3%).
Net revenues grew 8% to $1.149B, driven by strength in physical media including vinyl, CDs and expanded studio partnerships.
Channel mix shifted as wholesale growth outpaced direct-to-consumer; DTC represented about 34% of gross revenue, down from 37% the prior year.
Category performance was uneven: vinyl sales rose 13%, CDs increased 25% and physical movies grew 22%, while gaming declined 27% amid hardware cycle normalization.

Operational moves included acquisitions of Endstate (authentication technology) and Handmade by Robots, together with investments in warehouse automation and fulfillment capabilities to support scale and efficiency.
Expanded distribution agreements with Paramount and Amazon MGM broadened the company’s premium catalog and new-release access.
